label: r4c3
name: r3c5 + lr 3e-3 + 64 mb
hypothesis: This stacks both optimisation gains on r3c5: lr 3e-3 and 64 minibatches. If optimisation speed is the bottleneck at 1 epoch, this should be the most reliable, near or above 0.95. Refuted if it scores below either single change, which would mean the two together make updates too aggressive.
